variants.headline: Assess the shortfall before its causes
variants.body: Food supply is insufficient in {colony}, leaving people hungry. Practical provision, rather than confidence alone, is the relevant test of any response. Assessment should remain disciplined.

variants.headline: Food supply sets a practical benchmark
variants.body: People in {colony} are hungry: food supply does not meet their needs. An economic assessment must begin with that essential shortfall. Assessment should remain disciplined.

variants.headline: Scarcity requires disciplined judgment
variants.body: Food is insufficient in {colony}, and residents are hungry. A workable answer must connect its proposals to the practical need for adequate supply. Assessment should remain disciplined.
